name: omatic-server-connection
description: Connects a host to an O-Matic Server factory brain and ships Probot, Fred, Data and Embedder.
long_description: The MCP server that connects Claude Desktop to an O-Matic Server. One install serves many factories through a per-project .omatic/factory.json. Ships the Probot (orchestrator), Fred (storage and connection CRUD), Data (analyst and DBA) and Embedder (background vector refresh) skills. Connects to a factory brain; does not bundle a database.

project_root.title: Factory project folder
project_root.description: The folder containing .omatic/factory.json. This replaces the ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} variable used by the plugin build, which the desktop host does not expand — asking you for the path is the only way this host can know it.

node_path.title: Node binary path (optional)
node_path.description: Absolute path to a Node 18+ binary. Leave blank unless the bundled runtime fails; the server reports the runtime it actually resolved via omatic_runtime_status.
